methodologyNotes: Re-verified 2026-06-15 via WebFetch/WebSearch against official pricing pages. CONFIRMED DIRECTLY ON OFFICIAL PAGE: Printful (printful.com/pricing), Printify (printify.com/pricing/), Sellfy (sellfy.com/pricing/), Gooten (gooten.com/vim-program/), SPOD/SpreadConnect (spreadshop.com/spreadconnect/), Teelaunch (apps.shopify.com/teelaunch-1). Apliiq VIP ($29.99/mo, flat 20% discount, monthly-only) confirmed via official help article (discount+cadence) plus WebSearch for the price; the VIP signup page returns 429 (bot-block, page live). Gelato official pages (gelato.com/plus, gelato.com/subscription-plans, support.gelato.com) all return 403 (bot-block); Gelato+ priced at $23.99/mo monthly and $19.99/mo annual per two consistent 2026 review articles (dodropshipping.com, bootstrappingecommerce.com) — a single WebSearch summary cited $29.99/mo but is not corroborated by the dedicated review sources; resolved to $23.99 (medium confidence on this one figure). No Gelato+ Gold tier exists in 2026 (simplified to single Gelato+ plan). Redbubble fee structure (Standard 50% / Premium 20% / Pro exempt, $150 monthly cap, excess-markup fee, effective Sep 1 2025) confirmed via official help.redbubble.com help-center plus the official blog announcement (blog returns 403 to bots but is live). All membership/subscription fees priced at $0 for free-forever plans; per-item production costs recorded in plan notes only, never as monthlyUsd. Enterprise/custom tiers carry monthlyUsd=null. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

Plan becomes free once the store reaches $12,000/year in sales. 14-day free trial available.

vendors.name: Redbubble
vendors.provenance: Redbubble is a marketplace, not an API-based fulfillment network — no external platform integrations. Official tier/fee announcement (blog.redbubble.com/2025/08/artist-account-tiers-and-fees/) returns 403 to bots but is a live, canonical post; fee structure independently confirmed via official help.redbubble.com help-center article and multiple 2026 reviews. Fees effective Sep 1, 2025. No subscription cost on any tier (these are marketplace earnings-fee structures).

plans.name: Standard (free to join)
plans.notes: Free to join, no upfront or subscription fee. Platform charges a 50% fee on monthly earnings (only when you make a sale). Excess markup fee: markups above 20% incur a fee on earnings beyond that 20% threshold (artist keeps 50% of the excess portion). Monthly fee cap: $150. Default tier for new accounts. Confirmed via official help center + announcement.

plans.name: Premium (invite only)
plans.notes: No subscription fee. Assigned by Redbubble based on design quality, volume, activity, and commercial success. Platform fee reduced to 20% of monthly earnings. Excess markup fee still applies above 20% markup. Monthly fee cap: $150. Confirmed via official help center + announcement.

plans.name: Pro (invite only)
plans.notes: Reserved for top sellers with high sales and active engagement. Exempt from both platform fees and excess markup fees. No subscription cost. Eligibility thresholds not publicly disclosed. Confirmed via official help center + announcement.
